priceYear.quote: Sample costs for labor, materials, equipment and custom services are based on current figures. (Current at the time of the study, so the study year 2012 is used.)

acresFarmed.quote: The hypothetical farm consists of 105 contiguous acres farmed by the owner.

acresCrop.quote: Almonds are being established on 100 acres; roads, irrigation systems and farmstead occupy five acres.

laborMachineRate.quote: Hourly wages for workers are $12.50 for machine operators and $9.00 per hour non-machine labor.

laborNonMachineRate.quote: Hourly wages for workers are $12.50 for machine operators and $9.00 per hour non-machine labor.

capitalRecoveryFormula.quote: The formula for the calculation of the annual capital recovery costs is ((Purchase Price – Salvage Value) x Capital Recovery Factor) + (Salvage Value x Interest Rate).

salvageMethod.quote: Salvage value is an estimate of the remaining value of an investment at the end of its useful life.

machineLaborFactor.quote: Labor for operations involving machinery are 20% higher than the operation time given in Table 3 to account for the extra labor involved in equipment set up, moving, maintenance, work breaks, and field repair.
